lead_create has malformed character-split schema arguments; JSON fields and relation fanout are incomplete. Source remains unclaimed, no fabricated missing input/write surface.
Company owner alias is ignored by field_set when not directly mapped in set; only actual scalar columns certified.
Email_sendtolist/SMS/push and notes are DB records; no email delivery, campaign engine, report execution or integration network effects certified.
